summary: HUD gauge window: owns the gauge/flash part pointers and the ring/gauge2 animation lists of one battle HUD gauge.
evidence: Ui_GaugeWindow_InitPanes binds the 'gauge', 'flash', 'ring1'..'ring3', 'gauge2_base' and 'gauge2_flash' panes; Ui_GaugeWindow_InitPanesB stores the resolved child parts at +0x4C/+0x50. Vtable 0x0075D2AC.

fields.name: gaugePane
fields.evidence: Ui_GaugeWindow_InitPanesB finds the 'base_dummy' child and stores it at self+0x4C; Ui_GaugeWindow_InitPanes binds the same offset with the 'gauge' pane name

fields.name: flashPane
fields.evidence: Ui_GaugeWindow_InitPanesB finds the 'flash_dummy' child and stores it at self+0x50; the sibling 'gauge' string is bound to +0x4C immediately before
